title: Tiglath-Pileser III lists Menahem’s tribute
summary: Tiglath-Pileser III’s annals for his ninth palu name “Menahem of Samaria” among his tributaries.
description: Tiglath-Pileser III’s annals for his ninth palu name “Menahem of Samaria” among his tributaries. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (section “Menahem”, pp. 17–18; Table 1, row ~738, p. 38).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 738 BC (9th palu).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, section “Menahem”, pp. 17–18; Table 1, row ~738, p. 38
chronologies.note: Tiglath-Pileser III’s summary list of tributaries names Menahem of Samaria with the death of Pekah; CFAH reads it as geographical, not chronological.
